worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.summary: Gathers a puff of pollen that both stings and soothes, then lobs it at the chosen spot on a low arc: the first body it strikes decides the outcome — a foe is stung by sharp pollen, an ally (the user included) who is missing health drinks it and recovers. Striking a wall or running out of arc just disperses it, sparing everyone else. Solid walls block the path, and a third body on the line can intercept the puff. One puff, one target.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.0: One puff that harms at range and rescues allies
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.1: Deliver one whole puff onto a single foe or ally
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.2: Top up an injured self or ally between exchanges
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.description: The first living body the puff strikes decides the outcome: a foe takes one hit of about %1$s Bug special damage; an ally missing health (the user included) recovers %2$s%% of their maximum health, up to their missing amount. Native immunity or an impossible heal settles nothing. The target's special defence, type match-up and criticals settle on the hit.

It can be thrown as far as %1$s blocks. The puff settles only on the one body it truly strikes: whoever blocks it first gets the result; striking a wall or running out of arc merely disperses it at its real end point, never harming or healing those near the landing spot. Who you help or hurt is decided by who you actually deliver it to.
The puff flies on a low arc at %1$s blocks per tick and leaves after %2$s s of wind-up; a third body on the line can intercept it, and a wall or cover stops it first.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.nurture.on: Nurture on: about ×1.3 heal, at the cost of about ×0.8 blast and cooldown +6 ticks, to rescue allies and yourself.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.nurture.off: Nurture off (sting): about ×1.25 blast, at the cost of about ×0.75 heal, to burst foes.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.timing: Throw range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s, the heal to %3$s%%, and the throw range to %4$s.
On: about ×1.3 heal, at the cost of about ×0.8 blast and cooldown +6 ticks, to rescue allies and yourself. Off (sting): about ×1.25 blast, at the cost of about ×0.75 heal.
On: the companion throws pollen puffs at injured allies (below the threshold), spending its turn to heal. Off: it only uses them on itself and on foes, focusing on damage.
The companion only considers Pollen Puff when the target is this close; lower it to throw only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
An ally is healed only below this fraction of health; lower it to keep attacking, raise it to rescue as soon as anyone is hurt.
